dct_title_s: Babbitt SW Quadrangle, Minnesota - St. Louis County, 1951: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Babbitt SW quadrangle topographic map (N4730-W9152.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in ink and pencil regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area southwest of Babbitt. The hand written notations include information on the following: Northampton & Bath (NB) and the Dunka River Lumber Railroad line, logging camps noted with 'C' and Shank and Dunka River Lumber Company.
